name: Avishkar
description: Avishkar is the plane formerly called Kaladesh, a world of inventors saturated with aether and the home plane of Chandra Nalaar.

description_citations.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

summary.text: Avishkar is the plane formerly called Kaladesh, a world of inventors saturated with aether and the home plane of Chandra Nalaar.

citations.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: After the Mending left large amounts of raw aether available, the Great Aether Boom began on the plane, and aetherborn came into being as a byproduct of aether refinement.

citations.text: "Avishkar", section "Great Aether Boom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Aetherborn", section "Avishkar/Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The Consulate ruled it and seized Rashmi and her invention at the Inventors' Fair, which Tezzeret later had her expand into the Planar Bridge.

citations.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, discontent with the Consulate led to the nearly bloodless Indigo Revolution, organized and led by Pia Nalaar, which installed the Avishkar Assembly.

citations.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Avishkar", section "The Indigo Revolution and Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The Assembly's first act was to rename the plane from Kaladesh to Avishkar, and it then opened Omenpaths, set up embassies and held the first Ghirapur Grand Prix, a race across nearly two dozen planes.

citations.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Avishkar", section "The Indigo Revolution and Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: A second Grand Prix around 4564 AR drew teams such as the stranded Guidelight Voyagers and Far Fortune's gang, while Mohar Varma sat in jail for attempting a coup.

citations.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Guidelight Voyagers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Endriders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: Avishkar is united under the Avishkar Assembly and acts as a hub for interplanar trade and the Grand Prix; in the Echoverse it is still ruled by the Consulate.

citations.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Great Aether Boom begins as the Mending leaves massive quantities of raw aether available.
timeline.quote: Since the powers of the Planeswalkers were reduced, there were suddenly massive quantities of raw aether for the taking.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Great Aether Boom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venya Sangmi succeeds in creating a sol ring, displayed at the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: They eventually succeeded in creating a sol ring.

citation.text: "Sol Ring", section "Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rashmi builds a Sol Ring to capture foreign sunlight after Nissa's question.
timeline.quote: Rashmi built a Sol Ring to capture such light to test whether it would.

citation.text: "Sol Ring", section "Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avishkari advance teams deploy and find the treaties secured with the Saurid Autocracy were not signed with the full knowledge of other inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the beginning of the race

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "Second Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Avishkar, Rashmi works on the Matter Transporter, and Saheeli eventually relents and helps complete it.
timeline.quote: However, Saheeli eventually relented and helped Rashmi complete the device.

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate seizes Rashmi and her invention at the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: both inventor and invention were seized by the Consulate during their confiscation of submitted inventions

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret has Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret steals the Planar Portal by Bolas's order and builds it into his body.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret took it off the plane, and incorporated it in his body.

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate from power in a nearly bloodless revolution and installs the Avishkar Assembly.
timeline.quote: The Consulate was removed from power in a nearly bloodless revolution

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Indigo Revolution and Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Omenpaths open and the Assembly establishes embassies and holds the first Ghirapur Grand Prix, a chaotic race across nearly two dozen planes.
timeline.quote: a widely advertised event called the Ghirapur Grand Prix was held the year that the Omenpaths opened

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Indigo Revolution and Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate; the Avishkar Assembly is installed and renames the plane Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the Consulate was removed from power in the Indigo Revolution

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra wakes to Nissa reading in bed.
timeline.quote: Nissa. Her Nissa.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nissa reveals Chandra talked in her sleep about bringing her back to Zendikar and seems crestfallen.
timeline.quote: You were telling someone how much it would mean to you to bring me back to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nissa says she does not want Chandra to fix the problem for her.
timeline.quote: I don't want you to fix the problem for me.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia calls them to breakfast and teases Chandra as her turncoat daughter.
timeline.quote: Don't deprive me of one last breakfast with my turncoat daughter.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia laments that Chandra will not wear an Aether Ranger uniform.
timeline.quote: Of course, she won't be wearing an Aether Ranger uniform.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire emerges through an Omenpath onto Amonkhet to find the Speed Demons took first place and she is second.
timeline.quote: And Spitfire realizes it's not her.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra's injuries with concentrated light.
timeline.quote: Concentrated light illuminates Chandra's forehead, her back, her ribs

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth warns that a storm of primordial magic is leaving dragons on planes that never knew them.
timeline.quote: A raging storm of primordial magic has been flowing between worlds, leaving dragons in its wake.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth blesses Chandra and Nissa and vanishes in a flash.
timeline.quote: And many blessings on your relationship.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita reveals her father Mohar is in jail for attempting a coup.
timeline.quote: Considering he's in jail, I think he has worse things to worry about

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra hugs Sita and introduces Nissa.
timeline.quote: You really saved me and mom out there!

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Avishkar replaces Kaladesh and aether begins to flow freely to all.
timeline.quote: As Kaladesh became Avishkar, aether finally started flowing freely to all.

citation.text: Aetherflux Conduit (Aetherdrift Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nissa asks whether foreign sunlight could affect Avishkar's flora through Omenpaths and Rashmi builds a device.
timeline.quote: I built a device to capture such light for further testing."

citation.text: Sol Ring (Aetherdrift Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Guidelight Voyagers are stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home.
timeline.quote: The Guidelight Voyagers had been stranded on Avishkar with no way to get home.

citation.text: Voyager Quickwelder (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution ousts the Consulate.
timeline.quote: The Indigo Revolution ousted the Consulate once and for all.

citation.text: Thornwood Falls (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chandra joins the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team, in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Chandra chose to join the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace attacks the racers in Avishkar, rendering them unconscious and taking Loot back; Chandra is badly hurt.
timeline.quote: Jace rendered them unconscious, taking the child back.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Desparkening Daretti loses his spark and is stranded on Avishkar.
timeline.quote: In the Desparkening , Daretti lost his spark and was stranded on Avishkar .

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti bankrolls the Goblin Rocketeers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix hoping to find new interplanar travel.
timeline.quote: He bankrolled the team in the hopes of discovering a new means of interplanar travel after the loss of his spark.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti backs Chandra as she fights insurgents in Mohar Varma's attempted Consulate coup, which is prevented.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, the coup was prevented, although the Rocketeers did not place in the race.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate spends great resources trying to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders.
timeline.quote: The Consulate spent great resources attempting to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders, and was successful for some years.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Ghirapur Sprint". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the NCC becomes a major political party following the Indigo Revolution, the race is proposed as a tool of soft power.
timeline.quote: When the NCC became a major political party after Avishkar's Indigo Revolution , the race was proposed as a tool of soft power

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Ghirapur Sprint". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The chaotic inaugural Grand Prix, the first multiplanar race, crosses nearly two dozen planes; some teams are killed or lost, and Kylem's Cloudspire Racing Team wins.
timeline.quote: Kylem's team, the Cloudspire Racing Team , won this edition.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Avishkar Assembly expands the event beyond Avishkar to invite teams from many planes as an annual festival.
timeline.quote: the Avishkar Assembly sought to expand the event beyond the borders of Ghirapur and Avishkar itself

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The second interplanar Grand Prix is held around 4564 AR across Amonkhet and Muraganda with the Aetherspark as grand prize.
timeline.quote: The Aetherspark , an artifact that contained a planeswalker's spark , was offered as the race's grand prize.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur holds the first Ghirapur Grand Prix to showcase Avishkar.
timeline.quote: a widely advertised multiplanar racing event called the Ghirapur Grand Prix was held at least a year after the Omenpaths opened.

citation.text: "Omenpath", section "Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth sends the Speed Demon and Winter to win the Ghirapur Grand Prix and gives Winter Loot.
timeline.quote: He sent the Speed Demon and Winter to win the race and bring the Aetherspark back to Duskmourn.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Winter loses the race and Loot, Valgavoth conjures a door from Avishkar to Duskmourn and drags him back.
timeline.quote: Valgavoth conjured a door connecting Avishkar to Duskmourn, dragging the man back through it.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth defeats a dragon at the Ghirapur Grand Prix and heals Chandra.
timeline.quote: She then healed Chandra's wounds and informed her and Nissa that dragonstorms were moving through Omenpaths.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Dragonstorms". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace meddles with Chandra's mind at the Ghirapur Grand Prix, leaving her a strange mental link to him.
timeline.quote: After Jace meddled with her mind during the Ghirapur Grand Prix, Chandra developed a strange mental link to him.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Aetherborn spontaneously come into being on Avishkar as a byproduct of aether refinement, and inventors initially persecute them as mistakes.
timeline.quote: Initially, inventors persecuted the earliest Aetherborn, seeing them as "mistakes".

citation.text: "Aetherborn", section "Avishkar/Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate is overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution, and Kaladesh is reborn as Avishkar.
timeline.quote: The ruling Consulate has been overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution.

citation.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The plane is united under the new Avishkar Assembly, which plans to resurrect the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: The plane is now united under a new planar government called the Avishkar Assembly

citation.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Consulate announces a month-long fair that is secretly a deception to gather and control the plane's newest technologies.
timeline.quote: In truth, the Fair was a deception

citation.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The rebel Renegades thwart the Consulate's plan, clearing the way for Avishkar's new beginnings.
timeline.quote: Their plan was thwarted by a rebel group known as the Renegades

citation.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Far Fortune's gang is stranded on Avishkar and enters the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: they were stranded on Avishkar and quickly found their way into the Ghirapur Grand Prix

citation.text: "Endriders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Far Fortune competes in the second Grand Prix to use the Aetherspark to bring water to Gastal and control the plane.
timeline.quote: placing herself in control of the plane

citation.text: "Endriders", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fortune's gang is stranded on Avishkar and enters the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: they were stranded on Avishkar and quickly found their way into the Ghirapur Grand Prix

citation.text: "Far Fortune", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the final stage, Fortune's vehicle is wrecked and Jace mind controls her while trying to recover Loot.
timeline.quote: she was mind controlled by Jace Beleren

citation.text: "Far Fortune", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Far Fortune's stranded gang formed the Endriders racing team at the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Far Fortune and her crew found their way to the Ghirapur Grand Prix and formed the Endriders racing team.

citation.text: "Gastal", section "Omenpath Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Rocketeers arrive on Avishkar via a temporary Omenpath after breaking the velocity barrier.
timeline.quote: Redshift and his crew effectively broke through an enforced speed boundary and traveled through a fleeting Omenpath, arriving safely on Avishkar.

citation.text: "Goblin Rocketeers", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Guidelight emerge onto Avishkar from an Omenpath and wander the plane.
timeline.quote: The Omenpath they transited through essentially opened around them and deposited them upon Avishkar before closing again.

citation.text: "Guidelight Voyagers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mendicant encounters the Grand Prix and decides to use it to transit Omenpaths and return home.
timeline.quote: Under Mendicant's guidance, they deemed the infrastructure of the race to be a perfect iterative field

citation.text: "Guidelight Voyagers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, discontent with the Consulate and aether inequity spurred calls for change, with the NCC leading protests.
timeline.quote: discontent with the Consulate’s handling of the crisis and the inequitable distribution of aether spurred widespread calls for change

citation.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The NCC with former Renegades and allies coordinated a nearly bloodless coup that removed the Consulate, organized and led by Pia Nalaar.
timeline.quote: coordinated a nearly bloodless coup that removed the Consulate from power

citation.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Avishkar Assembly took power and its first act was to rename the plane from Kaladesh to Avishkar.
timeline.quote: The Assembly’s first act was to rename the plane from Kaladesh to Avishkar

citation.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new government reformed the class system and positioned Avishkar as a hub of multiversal trade and diplomacy.
timeline.quote: reforms to the class system were implemented, including instituting fair pay for the servants of the wealthy

citation.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Madhu dies in the New Phyrexian Invasion, leaving Mohar to raise Sita alone.
timeline.quote: Madhu died in the New Phyrexian Invasion , leaving Mohar to raise his daughter alone.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the first day of the second Ghirapur Grand Prix, Jace and Vraska break into Mohar's house offering to help him reinstall the Consulate.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Vraska broke into his house, claiming that they wanted to help him overthrow the Avishkar Assembly and reinstall the Consulate.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yanling loses her planeswalking in the Desparkening and travels via omenpaths to Avishkar to race in the Ghirapur Grand Prix hoping to find Li Shan.
timeline.quote: Yanling lost her planeswalking abilities in the Desparkening

citation.text: "Mu Yanling", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the beginning of the race

citation.text: "Saurid Autocracy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chordatans arrive on Avishkar through an instanced Omenpath and find themselves atop the food chain.
timeline.quote: having arrived via an instanced Omenpath to find themselves immediately atop the food chain

timeline.quote: she became the city's fastest taxi driver

timeline.summary: Venkat has a crisis of conscience over unjust arrests and leaves the Consulate to live as a private citizen.
